description_en: Updates the rules of a lifecycle management policy. Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported. UpdateLifecyclePolicy uses overwrite semantics. If a non-required parameter is left empty, the corresponding field is deleted. To append lifecycle rules, first call the DescribeLifecyclePolicies operation to obtain the current lifecycle rule configuration, append the new lifecycle rule configuration, and then call the UpdateLifecyclePolicy operation to update the lifecycle rule configuration
description_zh:
更新一个生命周期管理策略的规则。仅智算 CPFS 支持。

UpdateLifecyclePolicy 是覆盖语义，非必选参数为空则表示删除对应字段。当您需要追加生命周期规则时，请先调用 DescribeLifecyclePolicies 接口获取当前生命周期规则配置，然后追加新的生命周期规则配置，最后调用 UpdateLifecyclePolicy 接口更新生命周期规则配置
kebab_example: aliyun nas update-lifecycle-policy --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64y00000 --lifecycle-policy-id lsp-bp1234567890ab0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLifecyclePolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the file system. The ID starts with bmcpfs-, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****. To use CPFS for Lingjun, you must first submit a ticket to apply for the service whitelist and then create the file system in the NAS console.
Supported only when LifecyclePolicyType is set to OnDemand in the lifecycle management policy of a CPFS for Lingjun file system
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统 ID。以 bmcpfs- 开头，如 bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****。CPFS 智算版目前需先提交工单申请服务白名单，再通过 NAS 控制台创建文件系统。
仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的生命周期管理策略中 LifecyclePolicyType 为 OnDemand 时支持
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The tiered storage type. Valid values:
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class. This is the default value.
Archive: Archive storage class
parameters.help_zh:
分级存储类型。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储（默认值）。
Archive：归档存储
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the lifecycle policy.
Required for CPFS for Lingjun file systems
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期策略的 ID。
CPFS 智算版 文件系统必填
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the lifecycle policy.

Format:
The description must be 3 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
Supported only for CPFS for Lingjun
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期策略描述。

格式：
长度为3-64个字符，必须以字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
仅 CPFS 智算版支持
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The absolute path of the directory associated with the lifecycle management policy. This parameter is required when FileSystemId starts with bmcpfs-
parameters.help_zh: 生命周期管理策略关联目录的绝对路径。当 FileSystemId 以 bmcpfs- 开头时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: paths

fields.help_en:
The attribute of the rule.

Valid values:
Atime: the last access time of the file
fields.help_zh:
规则的属性。

取值：
Atime: 文件的访问时间
fields.name: attribute

fields.help_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
If Attribute is set to Atime, the value indicates the number of days that a file has not been accessed. Valid values: 1 to 365
fields.help_zh:
规则的阈值。

取值：
当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]
fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The data transition rules for files. You can configure up to one rule.

Supported only when LifecyclePolicyType is set to Auto for a CPFS for Lingjun file system
parameters.help_zh:
文件数据转储规则，最多配置 1 个。

仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的 LifecyclePolicyType=Auto 时支持
parameters.name: transit_rules

fields.help_en:
The attribute of the rule. Valid values:
RetrieveType: the retrieval method
fields.help_zh:
规则的属性，取值：
RetrieveType:  取回方式
fields.name: attribute

fields.help_en:
The threshold of the rule. Valid values for RetrieveType:
AfterVisit: supported when LifecyclePolicyType is set to Auto. This value indicates best-effort recall on visit.
All: supported when LifecyclePolicyType is set to OnDemand. This value indicates that all data is retrieved
fields.help_zh:
规则的阈值，取值：
RetrieveType
    - AfterVisit： LifecyclePolicyType=Auto 支持，代表尽力 recall on visit
    - All:  LifecyclePolicyType=OnDemand 支持，代表取回所有
fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The data retrieval rules for files. You can configure up to one rule.
Supported only for CPFS for Lingjun file systems
parameters.help_zh:
文件数据取回规则，最多配置 1 个。
仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统支持
parameters.name: retrieve_rules

fields.help_en:
The attribute of the rule.

Valid values:
Atime: the last access time of the file
fields.help_zh:
规则的属性。

取值：
Atime: 文件的访问时间
fields.name: attribute

fields.help_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
If Attribute is set to Atime, the value indicates the number of days that a file has not been accessed. Valid values: 1 to 365
fields.help_zh:
规则的阈值。

取值：
当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]
fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The expiration and deletion rules for file data
parameters.help_zh: 文件数据过期删除规则
parameters.name: delete_rules

The request status.

Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求状态。

包括：

true：请求成功
